title: Butternut Apple and Sage Soup
description: Sweet apple and sage balance the soft, earthy squash.

steps.title: Set up the pot
steps.text: Use the enamel Dutch oven on a medium burner; adjust the flame to hold a bare simmer.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.text: Melt {butter} and gently stir {sage} and {ginger} for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the squash, apple and {broth}. Cover and simmer 20–25 minutes until soft enough to crush easily.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Remove from the heat. Add {creamcheese} and blend smooth with the blender head submerged. Thin to taste with warm water.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers within 2 hours and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in meal-size containers for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: stir over medium-low heat to 165°F, adding a splash of water as needed. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat to 165°F. Dairy swap: replace each dairy ingredient with unsweetened oat milk or an equivalent dairy-free butter or cheese. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 151 kcal, 3.7 g protein, 22.2 g total carbohydrate, 6.6 g fat, 3.4 g fiber, 69 mg sodium.
